To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the development of AI systems should be done in ways that are responsible, and in ways that ensure the flourishing and wellbeing of humans.

(1) The development and use of AI systems is a social activity, (2) the design, development and use of these systems should be guided by ethical principles and values, (3) ethical principles are not universal, and are dependent on the context in which they are applied, (4) AI systems are not autonomous, and should not be considered as such, and (5) the responsibility for the use and development of AI systems lies with humans, and not the machines themselves.

1) the development of AI systems must take into account ethical values, moral and legal considerations; 2) AI systems must be able to reason about these values and be able to explain its reasoning; 3) the development of ethical AI requires a multidisciplinary approach, and 4) the development of responsible AI requires the integration of ethical considerations in all phases of the development of AI.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the ethical impact of AI systems, and the development of methodologies to ensure that AI systems respect fundamental human values and rights, and are able to reason in a way that is consistent with those values.

understanding and developing frameworks and methodologies that allow for responsible AI, and that can be applied to the development of autonomous AI systems, and to the development of the AI industry.
the ethical and moral aspects of intelligent systems
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ethics is the foundation of responsible AI, and responsible AI is the foundation of a responsible society.
ethics in AI is a broad, interdisciplinary and challenging field, which requires the involvement of many different disciplines and perspectives.

AI systems should be developed and deployed in a responsible manner, and that the ethical considerations should permeate all stages of the development process, from the initial requirements to deployment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the AI systems must be designed to respect human rights, and must be designed to be transparent, and accountable, and that the design of AI systems must respect the principles of human autonomy, dignity, justice and fairness, and non-maleficence.

we are developing a framework that can guide AI developers and users in their decision making, and help them to understand the ethical impact of their actions and to make decisions that are aligned with their personal values and societal values and regulations.

we need to ensure that AI systems are developed with the goal of human flourishing, in a sustainable world, and that we ensure the safety, privacy, and security of all stakeholders, including those that will be impacted by the decisions of the AI system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the development of AI systems must be guided by a responsible approach, and that such responsibility is a joint effort of all stakeholders, including researchers and developers.
we need to rethink our approach to AI, and we need to rethink responsibility.
the development of AI systems should be guided by ethical principles, that are not just added as an afterthought to the development process.
